Project description
Our client, a listed chemicals group headquartered in Germany, is redesigning its global treasury set-up. We are looking for an experienced treasury consultant to support the design and rollout of a new cash pooling structure and an in-house bank.

Requirements:
- Proven experience in treasury transformation projects in corporate groups
- Strong knowledge of cash pooling (physical and notional), netting and in-house banking
- Experience with treasury management systems (e.g. SAP TRM, Kyriba, Coupa Treasury)
- Understanding of FX hedging and hedge accounting under IFRS 9
- Business fluent English, German is an advantage

Conditions:
Daily rate: 1,100 EUR
Duration: 8 months
Mostly remote, occasional travel to Düsseldorf and Frankfurt
